cli.intro: WAE meta CLI — scaffold, build, stage native npm addons, and publish.

cmd.new: Scaffold a project from the open-tools or open-app template
cmd.build: Run the configured build: native → TS → UI → skills → staging
cmd.dist: Build and stage a cdylib into an npm platform package directory
cmd.publish: Verify npm package directories for a tag release; publishing needs Trusted Publisher (OIDC)
cmd.native: Inspect the native addon: resolved path, version, capabilities, audit
cmd.native-info: Resolve and load the native addon for the current platform
cmd.native-build: Build one configured native target and stage it into its platform package
cmd.native-stage: Stage an already built native artifact into its platform package
cmd.native-smoke: Load the staged addon and verify version, capabilities, probe and audit
cmd.native-audit: Query the audit records written by the native addon

opt.template: Template id: open-tools (minimal tool) or open-app (Open-X application skeleton)
opt.with-gui: Keep the GUI static page skeleton (open-tools only)
opt.out: Parent directory for the new project
opt.project: Project root to start config discovery from
opt.package: Cargo package override for the native step
opt.target: Native target key override, e.g. win32-x64
opt.dry-run: Plan the build without writing artifacts
opt.file: File name inside the platform package (e.g. tool.win32-x64.node)
opt.tag: Release tag to verify (defaults to GITHUB_REF_NAME in CI)
opt.cargo: Cargo workspace manifest for the [workspace.package] version check
opt.execute: Publish the 0.0.0 placeholder stub locally (real versions are rejected)
opt.ci: Publish via Trusted Publisher (OIDC) from GitHub Actions
opt.kind: Audit actor kind: user or agent
opt.capability: Capability name to filter audit records
